scope: C005.02-C005.04 password-file and core filesystem APIs; CLI rendering is excluded

atomic_write_failure_semantics.rollback: any post-publication failure restores the original destination from the retained-directory backup before releasing the lock

fixtures.setup: password path is a Unix FIFO created with mkfifo and has no writer
fixtures.expected: O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK open followed immediately by descriptor metadata validation returns typed NotRegularFile within a bounded timeout without reading

fixtures.setup: two-line update password path is a Unix FIFO created with mkfifo and has no writer
fixtures.expected: O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK open followed immediately by descriptor metadata validation returns typed NotRegularFile within a bounded timeout without reading

fixtures.setup: inject private key, salt, IV, UUID and destination
fixtures.expected: standard scrypt wallet is written with deterministic crypto fields and UUID

fixtures.setup: directory contains a strict valid JSON keystore with the imported key address
fixtures.expected: DuplicateAddress unless force_duplicate=true; force creates a second file but does not imply destination overwrite

fixtures.setup: destination already exists
fixtures.expected: TargetExists unless overwrite=true; overwrite remains independent from duplicate-address force

fixtures.setup: corrupt .json plus valid 0600 owner-owned wallet
fixtures.expected: corrupt entry is reported as SkippedInvalidJson and valid entry is returned

fixtures.setup: UTF-8 BOM precedes otherwise valid JSON
fixtures.expected: strict scan reports SkippedInvalidJson

fixtures.setup: valid strict JSON serialized across multiple lines
fixtures.expected: entry is accepted; scan differs from password-file multiline rules

fixtures.setup: .json symlink points to valid keystore
fixtures.expected: entry is not followed and produces SkippedSymlink

fixtures.setup: owner-owned regular .json has mode 0644
fixtures.expected: typed InsecurePermissions error identifies path and observed mode

fixtures.setup: regular 0600 .json owner differs from effective user
fixtures.expected: typed WrongOwner error identifies owner and effective user

fixtures.setup: configured final component is a symlink to an owner-owned 0600 regular wallet inside a secure owner-owned 0700 directory
fixtures.expected: descriptor-relative readlink/open resolution follows only the final link and returns DirectLoadFollowedSymlink from that same resolution

fixtures.setup: a parent component is a symbolic link
fixtures.expected: descriptor-relative nofollow parent traversal returns typed ParentSymlink without reading the target

fixtures.setup: keystore parent is not current-uid-owned mode 0700
fixtures.expected: operation fails with typed InsecureDirectory before key content is read or written

fixtures.setup: legacy object contains unquoted field names
fixtures.expected: direct load accepts compatibility JSON while directory scan rejects it

fixtures.setup: invalid JSON
fixtures.expected: typed Keystore JSON error; no scan-style skip

fixtures.setup: unique address and correct old password
fixtures.expected: same path is atomically replaced using standard scrypt, a new UUID/salt/IV, and the private-key-derived address

fixtures.setup: unique address and incorrect old password
fixtures.expected: typed keystore Invalid password error; original bytes remain unchanged and temporary file is absent

fixtures.setup: two valid files declare the requested address
fixtures.expected: DuplicateAddress; neither file is changed

fixtures.setup: selected .json entry is or becomes a symlink
fixtures.expected: scan/open refuses the symlink and does not mutate its target

fixtures.setup: inject serialization, write, file-fsync or rename failure before publication, or directory-fsync failure after descriptor-relative publication
fixtures.expected: every injection reports its typed AtomicWriteFailure and removes temporary/backup files; every failure retains or restores the original destination

fixtures.setup: a destination parent component is a symbolic link
fixtures.expected: descriptor-relative nofollow traversal returns typed ParentSymlink before sensitive bytes are written; neither destination nor temporary file is published through the link

fixtures.setup: an intermediate destination parent component is a Unix FIFO created with mkfifo
fixtures.expected: descriptor-relative directory-only traversal returns typed ParentNotDirectory within a bounded timeout without opening the FIFO for data, publishing the destination, or creating a temporary file

fixtures.setup: the verified destination parent is swapped after locking and immediately before retained-descriptor publication
fixtures.expected: publication detects ParentChanged and rolls back through the retained descriptor, restoring the original wallet in the displaced directory and leaving no temporary or backup file

fixtures.setup: POSIX filesystem
fixtures.expected: every parent component is opened descriptor-relative with nofollow; the temporary file is created with openat mode 0600, file is fsynced, publication uses renameat2/renameat/linkat relative to the retained parent descriptor, that same descriptor is fsynced, and final mode remains 0600

fixtures.setup: Windows/non-POSIX filesystem
fixtures.expected: descriptor-anchored sensitive publication is explicitly unsupported and returns typed UnsupportedPlatform without writing a destination
